[SWS_CM_00082] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging to an event and eventReceptionDefaultValue is not defined in case of Signal- Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If less data than expected shall be deserialized on the proxy side and the data to
be deserialized belongs to an Event and the eventReceptionDefaultValue is not
defined, then the data shall be discarded and the incident shall be logged.
⌋
